findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_insider, get_events, get_activist, get_form_d, get_subsidiaries, get_opportunities, get_congress · Private data: get_filings, get_activist, search_filings, get_form_d, get_subsidiaries, get_opportunities · Public sink: get_ratios.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_insider, get_events, get_activist, get_form_d, get_subsidiaries, get_opportunities, get_congress · Private data: get_filings, get_activist, search_filings, get_form_d, get_subsidiaries, get_opportunities · Public sink: get_ratios

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
